status: sector-level network check complete; pairwise lift/piste graph pending

rules.connected_means: A continuous route exists by ski lifts and marked pistes; a shared brand or pass does not by itself count as a physical link.
rules.counts: No lift-ride counts, fastest routes or ability matrices until the lift/piste graph is reproducible and checked against the official 2026/27 map.
rules.data_types: Operator-reported, independent-reported, map-derived and modelled values must remain separate.

groups.name: Main connected core
groups.note: The group is named by the Saint-Sorlin official ski-area page. Pairwise lift/piste edges and route dependencies still require a map audit.

groups.name: Saint-Colomban-des-Villards
groups.status: planned reconnection for 2026/27; operational link and pass coverage unverified
groups.note: The link was not maintained in winter 2025/26. Local-authority updates now say inspections and maintenance are underway for a planned 2026/27 restart, while Saint-Sorlin municipal council minutes still describe the area as closed and the domain as five ski areas. This supports a planned-reconnection status, not a claim that the connection is already operational.

edge_policy: Populate edges only from a dated lift/piste graph and cross-check each against the official map. Each edge must carry from_node, to_node, type, name, direction, easiest_piste_grade, lift_dependency, source, confidence and verification_status.

planned_reconnection.status: maintenance and major inspections reported; operational confirmation pending
planned_reconnection.publication_rule: Do not draw a connected edge, include Saint-Colomban in route counts, or assert full-pass coverage until the operator confirms the link is open and the pass terms.
